John (Twick) Donnelly, Brookville Park, Drogheda, Co. Louth and formerly of 8 Peter Street. 1st December 2025. Peacefully, surrounded by his loving family.  Predeceased by his parents Peter and Annie, brothers Jim and Ken. Loving dad to Lorraine, Ashley and John-Paul. John will be sadly missed by his daughters, son, Lorraine’s partner Rob, son-in-law Stuart, daughter-in-law Samantha, grandchildren Dillon, Holly, Danny, Louisa, Amelia and John, sisters Marian and Pauline, sisters-in-law Joan and Mary, wife Nancy, extended family and friends.

 

May John Rest in Peace.

 

Reposing at Townley’s Funeral Home, Crosslanes (A92 XN75) on Monday 8th December from 3pm until 7pm.

Removal from home on Tuesday 9th December at 11 o’clock walking to Our Lady of Lourdes Church arriving for funeral Mass at 11.30am which can be viewed live on  www.saintpetersdrogheda.ie

Burial afterwards in St. Peter’s Cemetery.

 

House strictly private at all times please.

 

Family would like to thank the staff in Oldbridge House, Moorehall Lodge, Drogheda, for their exceptional care and attention in looking after John’s needs.

 

Please leave a personal message of sympathy for the family in the Condolences section below.

 

When parking around the Funeral Home please have consideration for residents in nearby houses.
